clips.title: The story
paras: Along the Wetlands coast, Searing Coral is gathered from living iron coral beneath the sea. Tinkerers and smiths value the mineral-rich material for its unusual ability to endure heat and strengthen armor.

Searing Coral grows in the cold sea south of Menethil Harbor. The living iron coral thrives in saltwater, yet yields mineral-rich material that withstands extreme heat. Harvesters pry the hardened growths loose through dangerous surf, with coastal predators nearby.

Dwarven smiths do not traditionally work Searing Coral. In Ironforge, curious gnome craftsmen such as Klockmort Spannerspan use methods from veteran armorsmith Furen Longbeard. They smelt the coral and hammer it into metal alloys, making lightweight, durable armor for aspiring warriors.
